title: Insecure or outdated cryptographic algorithms / implementations
description: Detect weak, deprecated, or misused cryptographic algorithms and APIs such as MD5, SHA-1, DES, RC2/RC4, custom crypto, or improper encoding used as protection.
impact: The app uses the MD5 and SHA-1 hashing algorithms, both of which are vulnerable to collision attacks and should not be relied on for integrity or security-sensitive purposes.

remediation.guidance: Replace MD5/SHA-1 with a modern hash such as SHA-256 or SHA-3 for any security-relevant use (integrity checks, signatures, password-adjacent hashing).

resources.title: OWASP MASTG-TEST-0012: Testing Cryptographic Key Management
